name: Employer Spend Summary
query:
SELECT
  ep.name as "Employer:Link/Employer Profile:200",
  ep.company_name as "Company::200",
  ep.jobs_posted as "Jobs Posted:Int:120",
  ep.total_spent as "Total Spent:Currency:140",
  w.balance as "Wallet Balance:Currency:140",
  w.held_in_escrow as "Held in Escrow:Currency:140"
FROM `tabEmployer Profile` ep
LEFT JOIN `tabWallet` w ON w.party_type = 'Employer Profile' AND w.party = ep.name
ORDER BY ep.total_spent DESC
